scope: DataService file-backed H2 queue recovery across two separate Java processes on macOS
invocationPattern: Run each selection in a separate Maven 3.10 verify invocation from kura-cloud with JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-21.jdk/Contents/Home, -f runtime-tests/pom.xml, -Dmaven.repo.local=/Users/heyoulin/iot-kura-develop/migration-m2 and the same -Dkura.durability.dir=<archive>. Save the seed Failsafe XML before replay overwrites it. See kura-cloud/runtime-tests/README.md for reusable commands.
verified: The seed Failsafe JVM exited before the replay Maven invocation, and the two Failsafe JVM PIDs differ
A real Equinox/SCR H2DbService and DataService factory stack recovered the same unpublished message ID from the filesystem H2 database
The queued message was absent from the broker before connect, then replayed with the exact Unicode payload, QoS 1 and retained=false
The recovered message ID left the unpublished queue after MQTT delivery
Both invocations completed with BUILD SUCCESS and one passing Failsafe test each
limitations: The probe launches two isolated Equinox/SCR processes; it does not restart a deployed Kura gateway or its system service
The external Moquette broker uses loopback and in-memory broker storage; only Kura's DataService H2 queue is file-backed
No Linux, hardware, YOFC, PLC4X or official OPC UA validation was added
The 42 currently deferredValidation inventory rows retain their other stated boundaries
